name: aisend
description: AISend is a paid transactional email API built for AI agents to operate and humans to supervise: an agent sends from your verified domain, checks delivery and validates addresses over MCP or a Resend-compatible API, while you approve, review and can revoke access.
suggestedPrompts: Which sending domains are verified on my AISend account?
Show my 10 most recent emails and their delivery status
Draft a short email to me@example.com and show it to me before sending anything
